description: Alcantarillado colocadas, 2026 is a dataset listed in Dominican Republic national open data portal (datos.gob.do), an open data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Nacional De Aguas Potables Y Alcantarillado (INAPA). Este conjunto de datos contiene el Alcantarillado colocadas del Instituto Nacional de Aguas Potables y Alcantarillados (INAPA) generadas en el periodo 2026, en el cual se puede encontrar la cantidad de Alcantarillado colocadas en las diferentes provincias. Coverage: República Dominicana. The portal files it under the publisher Instituto Nacional De Aguas Potables Y Alcantarillado (INAPA). Its tags are Acueducto y Alcantarillado., Sociedad y bienestar, agua. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, ODS, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-04-22 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-do-portal.
